title: encrypt.rs ecdh_wrap_cek: AES-192-KW arm (kek_len == 24) is unreachable — remove or document
description: ecdh_wrap_cek() contains a match arm for kek_len == 24 (AES-192-KW). The only two call sites in this file pass wrap_key_bits = 128 and wrap_key_bits = 256, so kek_len is always 16 or 32. The 24-byte arm can never execute. It adds code complexity and risks confusion about whether AES-192-KW is actually supported. Options: (a) remove the arm and let it fall to the _ => Err(...) branch, or (b) add a comment explaining it is present for future use and is untested.
